title: Isithembiso Esikhulunywe Ngamafutha
intro: Umi eceleni komlilo ogwadule njengoba amalahle awo esakazeka ngokucophelela. Izivakashi ziyafika ukuze zihlangane ngokuthula, futhi umyalezo owodwa uvula indaba yesithembiso, isimanga, kanye nekusasa elingakagcwaliseki.
clues: Sawela ibanga elide ukuze sifinyelele inceku ethembekile ehlane.
Sicele ukuthi kusakazwe amalahle ukuze kulungiswe umlilo.
Sikhulume nomuntu owayebize ilangabi ukuba liphole futhi liphephe.
Silethe izindaba zosana olusanda kuzalwa kumuntu owayesedlule eminyakeni yokuba nezingane.
Saletha izindaba ezinhle zendodana ku-Ibrahim, futhi izindaba ezimangalisayo zashiya u-Ibrahim ehleka.
